T1.1.description: Gate-level tampering: injected rotations or substituted gates that alter behavior.

T1.3.description: Concealed identity structure: cancellation and separation patterns used to hide payloads.

T2.1.description: Ancilla information leakage: auxiliary qubits that carry data-dependent state.

T2.2.description: Encoded payloads: parameter grids and steganographic instruction encoding.

T2.3.description: Measurement manipulation: basis or pre-measurement gates that corrupt results.
